description: Real-football distributions for the simulator realism test (PLAN.md Step 3). Box-score stats come from StatsBomb Open Data men's matches (periods 1-4, shoot-outs excluded); passes exclude throw-ins, completion = pass without an outcome (StatsBomb convention). Distance covered comes from Metrica sample games 1-2 (outfield players with >= 85 minutes). 'band' is a suggested tolerance for the simulator's mean over many matches, not for a single match.

goals_per_match.band_rule: mean +/- 15% (for the mean over >= 200 simulated matches)

shots_per_team.band_rule: mean +/- 15% (for the mean over >= 200 simulated matches)

pass_completion_pct.band_rule: mean +/- 5% (for the mean over >= 200 simulated matches)

passes_per_team.unit: passes per team per match (excl. throw-ins)
passes_per_team.band_rule: mean +/- 15% (for the mean over >= 200 simulated matches)

header_share_of_shots.unit: fraction of shots that are headers
header_share_of_shots.band_rule: mean +/- 25% (for the mean over >= 200 simulated matches)

mean_shot_distance_m.band_rule: mean +/- 10% (for the mean over >= 200 simulated matches)

distance_per_outfield_player_m.unit: metres per outfield player per 90 min
distance_per_outfield_player_m.band_rule: mean +/- 10% (for the mean over >= 200 simulated matches)
